stories.title: Design Users Table Schema
stories.goal: define a users table that stores user account information and authentication details via Supabase Auth
stories.benefit: user authentication, profile management, and role assignments are properly supported with referential integrity
acceptanceCriteria: Users table includes id (UUID, primary key), email (unique), created_at, updated_at timestamps
Table integrates with Supabase Auth for authentication and session management
Schema includes optional fields for display_name, avatar_url, and user preferences
Table includes indexes on email for efficient lookups during login and registration
Foreign key relationships established for memberships and content ownership

stories.title: Design Leagues Table Schema
stories.goal: define a leagues table that stores league configuration and metadata
stories.benefit: all league spaces have consistent data structure with proper external platform references
acceptanceCriteria: Leagues table includes id (UUID, primary key), name, created_at, updated_at timestamps
Table includes external_platform (enum: 'sleeper'), external_league_id (unique per platform) for API sync
Schema stores league settings including team_count, season, scoring_format, playoff_structure
Table includes is_dynasty boolean flag for dynasty league handling and season continuity
Foreign key established to creator_user_id linking to users table for initial admin assignment

stories.title: Design Teams Table Schema
stories.goal: define a teams table that stores team information within leagues
stories.benefit: team data is properly structured for roster management, claiming, and historical tracking
acceptanceCriteria: Teams table includes id (UUID, primary key), league_id (foreign key to leagues), name, created_at, updated_at
Table stores external_roster_id for mapping to fantasy platform rosters for sync operations
Schema includes team_logo_url, win_loss_record (JSON), points_scored, and current_season fields
Table includes stable_fantasy_user_id for anchoring team continuity across seasons in dynasty leagues
Composite unique index on (league_id, external_roster_id) to prevent duplicate team imports

stories.title: Design Roles and Permissions Schema
stories.goal: define role types and permission levels for users within leagues
stories.benefit: access control, feature visibility, and administrative actions are properly enforced
acceptanceCriteria: Schema defines role enum with values: 'admin', 'manager', 'fan' with clear permission hierarchy
Admin role grants full league configuration, membership approval, and content moderation permissions
Manager role grants team claiming, commissioner desk access (if admin-designated), and full engagement features
Fan role grants read access, engagement features (comments, reactions, pick'ems), and optional team support
Role definitions stored as database constraints or enum types for consistent enforcement across queries

stories.title: Design League Memberships Table Schema
stories.goal: define a league_memberships table that tracks user participation and roles in leagues
stories.benefit: user-league relationships are properly managed with role assignments and approval workflows
acceptanceCriteria: Memberships table includes id (UUID, primary key), user_id (foreign key to users), league_id (foreign key to leagues)
Table stores role (enum: admin, manager, fan), status (enum: pending, approved, rejected), created_at, updated_at
Schema includes optional team_id (foreign key to teams) for manager role team claiming and fan team support
Table includes approved_by_user_id (foreign key to users) for tracking approval workflow and accountability
Composite unique index on (user_id, league_id) to prevent duplicate memberships

stories.title: Design League Settings Table Schema
stories.goal: define a league_settings table that stores per-league configuration options
stories.benefit: league visibility, join rules, and feature toggles are properly configured and enforced
acceptanceCriteria: League_settings table includes id (UUID, primary key), league_id (foreign key to leagues, unique)
Table stores visibility (enum: 'public', 'private') for league discoverability and access control
Schema includes join_rule (enum: 'auto_join', 'approval_required') for membership workflows
Table includes fan_access_enabled boolean for controlling fan role availability in league
Settings defaults established for new leagues: visibility='private', join_rule='approval_required', fan_access_enabled=true

stories.title: Design URL Slugs Table Schema
stories.goal: define a url_slugs table that stores unique league URL identifiers for routing
stories.benefit: leagues have stable, human-readable URLs (fshq.gg/LEAGUESLUG) with collision handling and edit support
acceptanceCriteria: URL_slugs table includes id (UUID, primary key), slug (unique, case-insensitive), league_id (foreign key to leagues)
Table includes created_at, updated_at, and created_by_user_id for tracking slug history and audit trail
Unique index on slug column enforces collision prevention at database level
Schema supports slug update history through created_at timestamp tracking for admin reference
Check constraint ensures slug format validation (alphanumeric, hyphens, lowercase) at database level

stories.title: Implement Foreign Key Relationships and Referential Integrity
stories.goal: establish all foreign key constraints and cascade behaviors for data consistency
stories.benefit: database maintains referential integrity and prevents orphaned records across all core tables
acceptanceCriteria: Teams.league_id references leagues.id with ON DELETE CASCADE to remove teams when league deleted
League_memberships.user_id references users.id with ON DELETE CASCADE to clean up memberships when user deleted
League_memberships.league_id references leagues.id with ON DELETE CASCADE
League_memberships.team_id references teams.id with ON DELETE SET NULL to handle team reassignments
League_settings.league_id references leagues.id with ON DELETE CASCADE to remove settings when league deleted

stories.title: Design Database Indexes for Query Optimization
stories.goal: create indexes on frequently queried columns to optimize read performance
stories.benefit: common queries for league lookups, membership checks, and team listings execute efficiently at scale
acceptanceCriteria: Index on leagues.external_league_id for fast league detection during connection flows
Index on league_memberships(user_id, league_id) for multi-league switcher queries
Index on teams.league_id for efficient team listing per league
Index on url_slugs.slug for fast league routing by URL (already enforced by unique constraint)
Composite index on league_memberships(league_id, status) for approval queue queries

stories.title: Implement Row-Level Security Policies
stories.goal: configure Supabase RLS policies to enforce access control at database level
stories.benefit: data privacy and security are enforced automatically for all database queries without application-level checks
acceptanceCriteria: Users table RLS policy allows users to read/update only their own profile data
Leagues table RLS policy allows read access based on membership status and league visibility settings
Teams table RLS policy allows read access to league members, write access to admins only
League_memberships table RLS policy allows users to read their own memberships, admins to manage all memberships
RLS policies leverage Supabase auth.uid() for secure user identification in policy expressions
